raw:
Before Dev turns toward the stairs, you ask what he has been working on upstairs.

He shifts the black case to his other hand. “Making the booth usable by someone who isn’t me, mostly. Projector’s behaving. I’m finishing the sound settings, labelling the connections, writing down what matters before somebody needs it in a hurry.”

He taps the side of the case. “These are the new hearing-assistance receivers. They arrived early, so I thought I could test them tonight. That needs sound through the auditorium and someone moving about in the seats, though, so it can wait.”

“It will wait,” Nell says, making a note on her clipboard.

Dev nods. “I’ve still got plenty to do without making a nuisance of myself.”

He heads back up the staff stairs with the case, his steps fading toward the projection booth.
